name: 德国求职机会卡
summary: 供非欧盟/欧洲自由贸易联盟人士赴德寻找合格工作，可走德国认可资格路线或至少 6 分的积分路线。
summaryEn: For non-EU/EFTA nationals seeking qualified work in Germany, through either a recognized-qualification route or a six-point route.

qualificationRoute.summary: 路线一要求德国学历或在德国完全认可的外国资格；路线二要求在取得国获认可的大学学历，或通常至少两年的职业培训资格。
qualificationRoute.summaryEn: Route 1 requires a German or fully recognized foreign qualification; route 2 requires a degree recognized in its country of award or generally at least two years of vocational training.

language.summary: 认可资格路线无法定语言证明最低要求；积分路线须至少德语 A1 或英语 B2。
language.summaryEn: The recognized-qualification route has no statutory language minimum; the points route requires at least German A1 or English B2.

points.summary: 仅积分路线须在基础资格和语言条件外达到至少 6 分。
points.summaryEn: Only the points route requires at least six points in addition to its basic qualification and language conditions.

livelihood.summary: 须证明求职期间资金充足；官网 2026 年标准为每月净额至少 1,091 欧元的冻结账户，或承诺声明。
livelihood.summaryEn: Job-search funds are required; 2026 guidance lists a blocked account of at least €1,091 net monthly or a declaration of commitment.

jobOffer.summary: 初始申请无需工作邀请；求职机会卡最初最长签发一年。
jobOffer.summaryEn: No job offer is required initially; the job-search opportunity card is first issued for up to one year.

sources.authority: German Federal Government — Make it in Germany
sources.title: Job-search opportunity card
